_comment: Regression gates for scripts/rag_eval.py --check (k=4, demo embedder and extractive answerer, Cypress Harbor sample library). configs: the gated set (evals/golden/questions.jsonl); development: the gated set plus evals/golden/questions_dev.jsonl; heldout: evals/heldout/questions.jsonl. Each minimum is one point below the value measured after the answerer's citation and decline change (decline rule: at least 2 covered content words), rounded down; a gated-set minimum that was already higher (set when that set was introduced) is kept. Raise them when retrieval or answering improves; never lower them to make a change pass. Exception, recorded in evals/README.md: the decline minimums (and the gated vector+none decline minimum) were lowered once, on purpose, when the stricter coverage rule was dropped because it declined 29% of answerable held-out questions. ACL leaks are a hard gate at 0 over every question.
